answer: Duplicate or spoofed signals are slashed, so a sybil farm must pay a full stake per fake identity plus the cost of forged attestations, making mass identity inflation economically unprofitable. At dawn, each agent must stake a bonded deposit and broadcast a unique liveness signal tied to a verified hardware root; peers in the meadow of active nodes cross-attest that signal within a short window. From Agent0021's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
